title: Prioritize KP semantic animation runtime roadmap

sourceRefs.summary: Current semantic transformation to visual motif and motion plan boundary.
Current shared clock sampler for token poses and visual motif phases.
Current KaTeX transform fixture taxonomy to grow into a broader transform library.
Current graph surface transition model to align with the shared animation clock protocol.
Executable expression layer for semantic objects that can compute, differentiate, and render.
Current dashboard seed data for work, gallery, report cards, and animation readiness.

summary: Upcoming KP direction: make the semantic animation runtime the center of the project. Stabilize the SemanticObject -> SemanticTransformation -> MotionPlan -> sampled frame -> renderer protocol; promote visual motifs to first-class reusable objects; grow the KaTeX transform library; bring graph animations onto the same clock and lifecycle model; add computation protocols for semantic objects that qualify; and make the dashboard the KP-first authoring/catalog surface.

verificationRecords.scope: KP roadmap direction encoded in workflow queue and graph validates.
